_comment: Made-up example. setup.ps1 copies this file to averaging_config.json (gitignored); put your real position there. cohort: small (miners and narrative small caps) or crypto (crypto names, filtered by the BTC drawdown). Buy limits: limits (absolute prices), limits_pct (relative to the price of the day) and custom_plans, e.g. {"two tranches": [[500, 2.05], [500, 1.35]]}.
